title: Three volume buses saved in profile v3, and a voice cap that ignores loops
intent: Let players set master, music and effects separately, and keep crowds from becoming a wall of noise without starving effects

attempts.approach: count every playing sound against the 20-voice cap
attempts.failureReason: music stems and the wind took 7 voices, leaving 13 for effects

evidence.description: v1 and v2 profiles migrate to v3 with music 0.6 and effects 1

constraints.statement: Master is scene.sound.volume; music is stem gain times the music volume; effects and loops are per-play volume times the effects volume
MAX_VOICES (20) counts only non-looping sounds; weapons and the player's or mech's own hurt always play
Profile settings are version 3 (shake, volume, music, sfx, muted); older versions migrate rather than reset

result.summary: effect voices peak at 3-7 in dense combat
